```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: mpg-plot
#| fig-cap: "Engine size and fuel efficiency"

ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Engine Size vs. Highway Fuel Efficiency",
    x = "Engine Size (liters)",
    y = "Highway Miles per Gallon",
    color = "Vehicle Class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

This line was written on a second machine.
